ResearchProjectDef.label: radio monitoring
ResearchProjectDef.description: Listen in on the planet's radio traffic: faction broadcasts, trader chatter and military bands. Unlocks the radio receiver. News reaches you faster and you learn more about every faction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: world communications protocols
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the protocols and call signs factions use to talk to each other. Raises your intel on every faction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: signal decoding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Break the simple ciphers on military and government channels. A large boost to intel, so restricted events start reaching you.

ResearchProjectDef.label: intelligence agency
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organise analysts, informants and archives into a proper intelligence service. Raises intel further; espionage operations build on it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: diplomatic corps
ResearchProjectDef.description: Train envoys in protocol, negotiation and etiquette. The foundation for formal treaties and summits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: intelligence networks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to run informants, contacts and agents abroad. Unlocks intelligence operations and counter-intelligence in the Dominion tab.
